items:
30A Escapes presents... “622 Western Lake Drive”, where charm and relaxation meet in the heart of WaterColor’s Park District. With space for up to 14 guests, including a cozy carriage house, this retreat truly feels like your home away from home. Start your mornings biking to the beach on one of the 7 included bikes, spend your afternoons lounging at the Beach Club, and wrap up your evenings exploring nearby shops and eateries. Let’s dive into the details below…👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Prime Location in WaterColor’s Park District – Enjoy the perfect blend of convenience and charm, just a short stroll from the beach, pools, and vibrant local shops.
✔ Carriage House with Queen Bed, Kitchen, and Private Balcony – Experience ultimate privacy and comfort in this cozy, self-contained retreat with a serene balcony to unwind.
✔ 7 Bikes Included to Explore Scenic 30A – Embrace the freedom of the open road and discover the beauty of 30A with beach bikes for the whole group.
✔ Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Pools, and Lazy River – Dive into luxury with exclusive access to first-class amenities designed for relaxation and fun.
✔ Multiple Balconies and Outdoor Living Spaces for Relaxation – Soak in the fresh air and peaceful surroundings from beautifully designed outdoor spaces perfect for lounging.
✔ Spacious Home Sleeping Up to 14 Guests – Gather family and friends in this expansive, welcoming home that’s ideal for creating unforgettable memories together.

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

⭐ "The property was exactly as described—clean, spacious, and just a short walk to the beach. Perfect for large groups!" – Michael
⭐ "The location was perfect, just steps from the pools and beach. The house itself was beautifully maintained, with plenty of room for our family." – Judy
⭐ "The carriage house was an amazing bonus. We loved the proximity to Seaside and WaterColor amenities. Fantastic vacation!" – Mark

★☆ LIVING AREAS ☆★

Immerse yourself in Florida charm and unmatched comfort within the expansive living spaces of this breathtaking home. The open-concept living room boasts a decorative fireplace and a sleek Smart TV, creating the ultimate retreat to unwind after a sun-soaked day at the beach. Elegant French doors open to beautifully furnished, covered porches, offering the perfect setting to savor serene outdoor moments in style.

✔ Sleek Built-In HDTV Entertainment Center for Ultimate Relaxation
✔ Ultra-Plush, Expansive Seating Designed for Comfort and Perfect for Hosting Large Gatherings
✔ Stunning French Doors Leading to Elegantly Furnished Porches, Ideal for Outdoor Entertainment and Relaxation

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Crafted for unforgettable family gatherings, this gourmet kitchen is a true chef’s paradise. Featuring top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, gleaming granite countertops, and a spacious island breakfast bar, it’s perfectly equipped to help you create culinary masterpieces. The adjoining dining room elevates every meal with elegant seating for 12, complemented by a charming kids’ table that comfortably seats 4—ensuring everyone has a place at the table for moments that matter most.

✔ Modern, Fully Equipped Kitchen with Sleek Stainless-Steel Appliances
✔ Elegant Granite Countertops with a Spacious Island Seating for 3
✔ Large Dining Room Table for up to 12 Guests, Plus a Charming Kids’ Table for 4

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Relax and recharge in the stunning outdoor spaces of this home. Lounge on the beautifully furnished porches and balconies, or savor moments in the breezeway—a perfect spot for evening barbecues or tranquil mornings with a cup of coffee. Enjoy the convenience of a propane grill for al fresco dining, an outdoor shower to refresh after a day in the sun, and a private parking area to make your stay seamless. Every detail is designed for your comfort and leisure.

✔ Spacious Furnished Porches and Scenic Balconies for Relaxing Views
✔ Premium Outdoor Propane Grill with a Breezeway Dining Area Perfect for Gatherings
✔ Convenient Outdoor Shower for Effortless Beach Clean-Up

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

Designed for comfort and privacy, the 5 bedrooms are spread across the main house and the carriage house. Each bedroom features plush bedding, Smart TVs, and private en-suite bathrooms to ensure a luxurious stay.

1st Floor
✔ King Guest Bedroom: Luxurious Suite featuring a King Bed, Smart TV, direct Porch Access, and a Spa-Like En-Suite Bathroom with an Oversized Walk-In Shower
✔ Half Bathroom: Convenient Half Bath on the 1st Floor for Guest Use

2nd Floor
✔ Primary Bedroom: Spacious King Bedroom with direct Porch Access and a luxurious En-Suite Bathroom
✔ King Guest Bedroom: Elegant Guest Bedroom featuring a King Bed, private Balcony Access, and a stylish En-Suite Bathroom
✔ Bunk Room: Fun and Functional Bunk Room with 3 sets of Twin Bunk Beds and a Private Bathroom for added convenience

3rd Floor
✔ Spacious Twin Loft Room with Stunning Gulf Peek Views and Cozy Daybed

Carriage House
✔ Luxurious Queen Bedroom featuring a Private Balcony, a Fully Equipped Kitchenette, and an Elegant En-Suite Bathroom with a Spacious Walk-In Shower

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Immerse yourself in the vibrant charm of WaterColor, a coastal paradise just steps from the beach. Stroll through boutique shops, savor delicious meals at local restaurants, and enjoy an array of activities for all ages. Relax on the pristine sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, or hop on a bike for a scenic ride to the iconic Seaside. WaterColor offers the perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and coastal beauty!
✔ Steps to Scenic 30A and Nearby Seaside Community - Immerse yourself in the charm of Scenic 30A and the vibrant Seaside community, full of boutique shops, local dining, and a relaxed coastal vibe just moments away.
✔ 4-Minute Walk to Boathouse Pool - Unwind at the tranquil Boathouse Pool, perfect for a peaceful retreat or a refreshing swim just a short stroll from your door.
✔ 7-Minute Walk to WaterColor Beach Club and Poolside Dining - Enjoy the luxury of the WaterColor Beach Club with its pristine beachfront, upscale poolside dining, and unbeatable sunset views, all just a few minutes away.
✔ 4-5 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor (Lazy River and Slides) - Bike to the family-friendly Camp WaterColor, featuring a lazy river, water slides, and plenty of fun, creating unforgettable moments for all ages.

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ Garage is NOT accessible to guests.
✔ Indoor fireplace is NOT for guest use.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★

Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Watercolor, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Seaside Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with swimming nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with cycling.
